iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DHCPv4::yiaddr
       This command returns yiaddr(your IP) field from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::yiaddr

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns yiaddr(your IP) field from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::yiaddr

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns yiaddr(your IP) field from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Yiaddr [DHCPv4::yiaddr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
